official: 横浜市小児の医療費助成に関する条例の一部改正

sources.label: 議案一覧（令和8年第1回定例会）

name: 小児医療費助成を18歳年度末まで拡大
summary: 現在の助成対象は、原則として中学校卒業までです。この議案で、対象年齢を18歳に達した日以後の最初の3月31日までに広げ、助成を受ける人や支払い方法も見直します。令和8年6月1日に施行します。
changes: 助成対象を中学校卒業までから、18歳に達した日以後の最初の3月31日までに広げる
助成を受ける人を、原則として保護者とし、特定小児は本人とする
医療証を提示して受診した場合、市が医療機関に助成額を支払う方法にする
who: 横浜市内に住み、健康保険に加入する18歳年度末までの子ども
対象となる子どもの保護者
why: 対象年齢を引き上げるなどのためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Extends child medical expense subsidies until March 31 after a child turns 18
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Yokohama City Ordinance on Subsidies for Children's Medical Expenses
en.summary: Currently, children are generally eligible for subsidies only until they graduate from junior high school. This bill extends eligibility until the first March 31 on or after a child's 18th birthday, and also revises who receives the subsidy and how it is paid. It takes effect on June 1, 2026.
changes: Extends eligibility from graduation from junior high school until the first March 31 on or after a child's 18th birthday
Makes the parent or guardian the subsidy recipient in principle, and the child the recipient in the case of specified children
Makes the city pay the subsidy amount to the medical institution when a child receives care after presenting a medical care certificate
who: Children who live in Yokohama City, are enrolled in health insurance, and are eligible until the first March 31 on or after their 18th birthday
Parents or guardians of eligible children
en.why: The city says the change is being made to raise the eligible age, among other reasons.
